decisions.reason: Removing the separate lip-sync requirement does not alter the current realism or native-looking UGC criteria, which contain no lip-sync attribute.
The product pack-shot requirement is independent of dialogue lip sync and remains semantically unchanged.
The requirement to include both products does not depend on dialogue lip sync.
Actor nationality and gender preferences remain valid independently of the removed lip-sync standard.
The opening-hook content and market-alignment constraints are independent of dialogue synchronization.
Removing lip-sync accuracy does not resolve or modify the separate audio-level and mix-standard requirements.
The subtitle standard remains applicable independently of whether dialogue lip sync is required.
The short-preview deliverable may still contain visuals and dialogue without requiring accurate lip synchronization; no current attribute becomes obsolete.
Hindi-only script and dialogue constraints remain valid independently of lip-sync execution.
The selected reference basis and adaptation method do not depend on the separate lip-sync requirement.
Keyword selection and wording constraints are independent of dialogue lip synchronization.
Product-benefit and claim content remains semantically unchanged by removal of the lip-sync standard.
